name: Hexagon (bezel + hidden halo)
composition: 3 velvet studio + 7 closed-hand (4 close-up + 3 wider), docs/10
design_profile: BEZEL-SET SOLITAIRE, yellow gold. CENTRE: one elongated HEXAGON step-cut diamond, six-sided outline, two long parallel sides, angled clipped corners, set EAST-WEST (long axis across the finger), FULLY BEZEL-SET in a continuous smooth polished rim following every angle of the hexagon. NO prongs or claws anywhere. HIDDEN HALO: single row of small round brilliant pave around the UNDERSIDE of the bezel, following the hexagonal outline, visible only from side/three-quarter angles - never a halo on the top face. SHANK: thin plain polished ROUND band with a small open shoulder void at the head. No side stones, top halo, shoulder pave or milgrain.

hexagon_family_disambiguation.LR-0195: THREE-STONE - tapered baguette sides, FLAT squared shank, hexagonal openwork basket, prong-set

notes: Velvet slots 1-3 are CLEAN plates - logo composited locally afterwards.

Two failure modes guarded in every prompt: (a) adding prongs - this ring has NONE, the bezel is continuous; (b) promoting the hidden halo to a visible top halo - the pave sits UNDER the bezel and must not appear on the top face. The top-down prompts say so explicitly.
Slot 5 (macro side-of-finger) is the money shot for this SKU - it is the only angle that reads the hidden halo.
